author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic art team
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Looking for people to grow in comics and illustration. OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Seeking serious, consistent teammates. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until all positions are filled.

author: attenboroughac
title: Paid floral mural painter for exhibition
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Need a painter confident following floral/leaf references, comfortable with acrylics, able to adapt to exhibition requirements and finish in the given timeframe. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration: 3 days, 28–30 September 2026. Location: Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio explaining suitability, portfolio/examples or website/Instagram to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
